github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Write the commit message in English.
Follow the Conventional Commits specification (e.g., feat:, fix:, chore:, refactor:).
Keep the first line under 72 characters.
Do not end the first line with a period.
Use the imperative mood in the title (e.g., 'add' instead of 'added' or 'adds').
